descript.abstract: This data set provides eight feature classes. The base feature class is called esri_zp and isn't generalized. The weighted centroids feature class is called esri_zp_cent. The centroids are weighted by the U.S. Block Centroids population distribution. Use the weighted centroids in report aggregation and spatial overlay operations. The esri_zp and esri_zp_cent feature classes contain all the attributes. There are six generalized boundaries feature classes and called: esri_zp_gen2, esri_zp_gen3, esri_zp_gen4, esri_zp_gen5, esri_zp_gen6 and esri_zp_gen7. Use the generalized boundaries when creating study areas.
descript.purpose: U.S. ZIP Codes provide detailed boundaries that are consistent with the tract and county data sets and are effective at the national level.
descript.supplinf: Largest scale when displaying the data (non-generalized feature classes): 1:100,000.

citeinfo.title: U.S. ZIP Codes, U.S. ZIP Codes Centroids, U.S. ZIP Codes (generalized)
citeinfo.othercit: U.S. Block Centroids provides geospatial data to create the weighted centroids feature class.

procstep.procdesc: The following steps were performed by Esri: For unchanged Geographies, Block Groups, Tracts, Counties, States and US: The data sets were copied from Esri Business Analyst 10. All attributes were removed but ID, NAME, STATE_NAME, ST_ABBREV, AREA, Shape, and Genshp (the generalized Shape attribute). The following Geographies: CBSA, DMA, and Zip5 boundaries, used the Jan 2014 Teleatlas release of these data sets. All geographies reprojected all the data layers to Web Mercator (Auxiliary Sphere). An in-house, custom tool was used to generate a weighted centroid shapefile of this data set from U.S. Block Centroids. The Esri Community Data attributes were joined, which were exported out of our Data Production environment into FGDB format.

dataqual.logic: The data set is converted to FGDB (File Geodatabase) format using either Esri Geoprocessing tools in ArcGIS.
dataqual.complete: After processing, the data set is checked for drawing display and number of records and file sizes compared with source materials. This data set provides two levels of generalization.

horizpa.horizpar: The horizontal positional accuracy is 167 feet for the base feature class <data set name>. This feature class also has the highest horizontal positional accuracy.

dataIdInfo.idPurp: U.S. ZIP Codes provides detailed boundaries that are consistent with the tract and county data sets and are effective at the national level.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: This data set provides eight feature classes. The base feature class is called esri_zp and isn't generalized. The weighted centroids feature class is called esri_zp_cent. The centroids are weighted by the U.S. Block Centroids population distribution. Use the weighted centroids in report aggregation and spatial overlay operations. The esri_zp and esri_zp_cent feature classes contain all the attributes. There are six generalized boundaries feature classes and called: esri_zp_gen2, esri_zp_gen3, esri_zp_gen4, esri_zp_gen5, esri_zp_gen6 and esri_zp_gen7. Use the generalized boundaries when creating study areas.
